title: Dative: recipient and advantage
subtitle: Ask who receives or benefits.
overview: The dative can name a recipient or the person for whose benefit an action is done.
Start with the verb’s meaning: giving, speaking, showing, and helping commonly invite this question.

items.grc: ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τέκνα θεοῦ γενέσθαι.
items.en: He gave them authority to become children of God.
